description: §14.12.6.2 (S482) — `return a as.Published;`: the `.` touches `as`, so it is member access on the name `as`, not the bare variant of an `as .V` cast. The statement is `return a` followed by `as.Published` with no `;` between — E-STMT-MISSING-SEMICOLON.
rationale: §14.12.6.2: "a `.` touching `as` — no whitespace, line break or comment between them — is member access on the name `as` (`as.value`, `as.f()`), and a `.` separated from `as` by any of those begins the bare variant of the cast". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-as-adjacency — "a `.` touching `as` with no space is member access; a spaced `as .V` stays a bare variant." §7.2.2: a `;` ends every statement that is not block-like.
